Subject: NovaRise -> Redwood: onboarding docs and PO routing

Hi Hannah —

Happy Friday. We're getting close to the activation date for our pilot (targeting Oct 20) and procurement needs the standard security and contracting artifacts to finish internal gating. Can you send (or point me to):

- Executable DPA (or draft we can review)
- SOC 2 report link or summary of scope
- Current subprocessor inventory for any data-processing services used by Redwood
- PO instructions (billing contact, remit-to, preferred payment terms) and any required PO template

We have a standard intake checklist and can share ours if that helps. Attachment: subprocessor_template_request.xlsx (one-pager) — please confirm if anything else is required by your legal/procurement teams.

Thanks,
Sarah

Subject: Re: NovaRise -> Redwood: onboarding docs and PO routing

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the note and the timeline — we'll prioritize this so you can keep the Oct 20 pilot go-live. Attaching our current DPA (Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf). A few quick items:

- SOC 2: we host an active report on our security portal; can you accept a read-only link? If yes I will send the public URL. If NovaRise requires a sealed/certified copy we can coordinate with our security team for an export.
- Subprocessors: can you confirm whether you need a CSV export or an attest-only statement? We can provide both; I will loop in Ben (procurement ops) to attach the latest inventory
- PO routing: what's NovaRise's preferred remit and payment terms (Net30/Net45)? We typically accept standard Net30; we can also issue a vendor invoice after PO is created. If you have a PO number to include, reply with it so we can tag the invoice.

Ben — assigning to you to share the subprocessor inventory and confirm billing flow.
Laura — FYI on the DPA; we have a couple of small redline preferences (data retention window, subprocessor notice timeline) — if we need a counter-sign cadence or a legal redline call, please advise.

I'll follow up once Ben confirms attachments.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: Sarah Ortiz <sarah.ortiz@novarise.com>

Date: 2026-10-05T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaRise -> Redwood: onboarding docs and PO routing

Thanks, Hannah — appreciate the quick turnaround.

We can accept a read-only SOC 2 link initially. Here's what I'm attaching/including:
- subprocessor_inventory_NovaRise.csv (attached) — our internal mapping for connected services
- SOC2 link: https://novarise.com/security/soc2-report-2026.html (public) — scope: infrastructure + platform + change management
- DocuSign link to initiate signature on DPA: https://app.docusign.com/Redwood/DPA/NR-019

PO details: NovaRise will issue a PO with Net30 terms. Primary AP contact is AP Team <ap@novarise.com>. Please provide Redwood's remit-to details and preferred invoice routing address so we can match the PO. We usually route PO documents through our procurement portal (PO# will be included).

If you can also supply the PO template you prefer we can attach that on our side — otherwise we'll use our standard PO and include the PO# when it's ready.

Small ask: can we confirm any subprocessor changes within 10 business days of notice (per our internal policy)? If Redwood's notice cadence is different, please note so we can align approvals.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20 min call if that's faster.

Sarah Ortiz
Procurement Lead, NovaRise
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ortiz <sarah.ortiz@novarise.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaRise -> Redwood: onboarding docs and PO routing

Hi Sarah — thanks for the SOC2 link and the CSV. Quick operational notes and next steps from procurement/finance:

1) PO routing and remit: please route the PO to AP Team <ap@novarise.com> as you've indicated. Redwood remit details are in the attached PO template (PO_template_NovaRise.xlsx). For invoices, please email invoices@redwood.com and include the PO# and deal id (NR-2026-019) on the invoice line.

2) Payment terms: Net30 is acceptable. If NovaRise's portal mandates specific invoice metadata, include that in the PO and we'll accommodate.

3) DPA status: we reviewed Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf and summarized the proposed redlines below for transparency; none are blocking but Laura / Legal will confirm:
   - Retention: narrow default log retention to 90 days for debug logs (customer data defaults remain per contract)
   - Subprocessor notice: request 10 business days' notice — legal prefers 15; Laura, can you confirm whether 10 is acceptable or we'll propose a middle ground?
   - Data export assistance: clarified that production export support is via dedicated eng runbook and SLA (included as an addendum)

4) Subprocessor inventory: attached is the latest export (subprocessor_inventory_redwood_20261007.csv) for your review. If you need any attestations, we can provide a signed roster.

Next steps:
- Hannah will coordinate a quick call if NovaRise wants to walk through the DPA redlines (20 min).
- Laura will send back any formal legal redlines by EOD 2026-10-08.
- Once PO is created on your side, send PO# to invoices@redwood.com and we'll issue the onboarding invoice tied to the committed pilot capacity.

Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
